axis_supply.supply_status: Strained. Light division with smaller logistical footprint than panzer divisions, but still suffering from Mediterranean interdiction. Fuel and ammunition adequate but declining. Water critical in desert heat.

allied_supply.supply_status: Recovering from heavy July casualties (2,305 losses at Ruweisat Ridge and El Mreir). Adequate supply lines from Alexandria and Cairo (100-150km) but division under strength. Reinforcements arriving but not yet integrated. Primary constraints: manpower replacement from limited NZ population pool, equipment losses.
